name: Goblin Sponsorship
summary: Baron Revilgaz is seeking the Venture Company’s new fuel regulator plans for Pozzik at Lake Nazferiti. Foreman Cozzle has outsmarted him, so the Baron sends you after the blueprints.

sections.title: The Foreman's Blueprints
sections.body:
Baron Revilgaz says the Venture Company’s shredders at Lake Nazferiti in northern Stranglethorn carry a new model of fuel regulator. Pozzik could use its details, but Foreman Cozzle has proved cleverer than the Baron expected. So Revilgaz believes you may have better luck finding the plans.

The blueprints are kept in Cozzle’s house, almost certainly under lock and key. The Venture Company’s base lies around Lake Nazferiti, in the vale’s north-eastern corner. Cozzle keeps the key in his cabin atop the oil tower. The box of blueprints is in the small house near the tower’s base. Revilgaz admits the gnome team there is good, and his team needs every advantage it can find.

sections.title: A Copy for the Baron
sections.body: Revilgaz wants a copy of the blueprints for his own notes. Then he sends you to Pozzik, so the goblin does not think one of his sponsors has abandoned him.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz want fuel regulator blueprints?
faq.answer: The Venture Company’s shredders at Lake Nazferiti carry a new model of fuel regulator. Revilgaz believes Pozzik could use the details.
The blueprints are in a box inside a small house at the foot of the oil tower, at the Venture Company’s base by Lake Nazferiti in northern Stranglethorn.
Foreman Cozzle carries the key and works in the cabin atop the oil tower.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
faq.answer: Wharfmaster Lozgil sent you to Baron Revilgaz in the previous step, Goblin Sponsorship number three. Goblin Sponsorship number five comes next.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can pick the lock on the blueprints box without Cozzle’s key.
